commands.assertions: X11 fixture captures the authenticated prior window, translates reparented and negative geometry to root coordinates, preserves focus, and fails closed when permission or window evidence is invalid.

assertions: Prior-window bounds preserve root coordinates through reparenting and negative monitor positions.
Capture does not change the active focus and refuses missing, stale, or unauthorized window evidence.
limitations: This is deterministic Xvfb/X11 evidence; Wayland, Windows, and macOS rows remain separate.
